currentTask.title: M2 Tabletop mode with opposite-facing top row

requirements.text: Add Tabletop alongside Pass-around and Focus. Four-seat boards rotate the entire top two player panels 180 degrees, bottom panels remain upright; preserve seat order. Two-seat Tabletop uses one column/two rows with only upper panel rotated; reserve adequate height or fall back to Focus. Keep inward name/tracker bands and clear central menu pocket. Controls remain minus-left/plus-right from each seated player perspective, with 48px targets.

Mode changes, paging and viewport/density changes preserve stable identities, seat order, life and poison. Keep existing contiguous paging and anchor page when switching Pass-around/Tabletop. In automatic narrow/short-screen Focus, keep Tabletop preference and return to rotated board when space permits. Explicit Focus remains upright.

Table menu exposes Tabletop, remains modal during changes, Escape/Done restores focus. Rotated life and tracker controls operate the correct player; poison inspector and global menu remain upright, reachable and keyboard usable. Opening menu or switching views never adjusts counters.

Use existing shared React components without new dependencies. Add Storybook Tabletop examples for two/four players and paging; tests verify orientation, responsive fallback, state preservation, menu/modal focus and rotated controls in a real browser. Preserve existing checks and behavioral suite.

nonGoals: No six-up density, gestures, undo, persistence, networking or player management. No unrelated new features or audit-policy changes.
This ticket adds Tabletop to the existing uncommitted responsive implementation; prior responsive Codex review is pending. Do not claim physical-device or screen-reader validation.
